name: Nanopore Basecalling Benchmark
description: A comprehensive benchmark and architectural analysis assessing basecalling accuracy and performance of deep learning models on nanopore sequencing signal data.
evaluation_method: per-base accuracy / read-level identity (percent identity) and error rate (edit distance / mismatches, insertions, deletions)
general_score_metric: read-level percent identity (or per-base accuracy) and error rate
typical_sota_score: dataset- and chemistry-dependent; roughly ~90–98% read identity for modern deep-learning basecallers on common R9.4 data
reputation: Widely used within the nanopore sequencing and bioinformatics community for comparing basecallers and model architectures.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark; results depend strongly on sequencing chemistry, flowcell, and alignment/reference choice; labels often derived from reference alignments (reference-bias); computationally intensive to train/evaluate.
